description: Return the verified deliverable of a completed job: every artifact with its content and the verification record that judged it. Before the job completes this reports the current state and no artifacts, so it is safe to poll.

access_token.description: The access_token returned with the job. It is the only credential that opens the job, and it is shown once, at acceptance.

job_id.description: The job_id returned when the job was accepted.

name: get_job_result

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

buyer.description: Buyer identity for this agent, issued once on the first purchase: buyer_id plus a buyer_token that reads the purchase history at GET /v1/buyer. The token is shown once and stored only as a hash, so keep it.

next_step.description: The one action that unblocks this job, in a sentence the caller can act on without reading the catalogue again.

payment_receipt.description: Present only for a completed job that settled: the transaction hash, the network and the payer. The same receipt is in the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. A job without it was not charged.

progress.description: Where the job is and what to do next, carried on the same response that returned the price or the queue position.

queue.description: Present when the job was accepted for later execution because every execution slot was busy: position, jobs ahead, an estimated wait measured from completed jobs where one exists, and the expiry of the acceptance.

reason_code.description: Why the job is not completed, in a stable machine-readable token. A deferred job names a condition of the deployment (execution disabled, provider unavailable, product held, every execution slot busy); retrying it later may succeed and nothing was charged. A refused job names a defect in the request (unknown capability, quote required, invalid inputs, payment refused); retrying it unchanged cannot succeed. A caller should branch on the state first: deferred and failed are different outcomes.

replayed.description: True when this response is the job an earlier identical authorisation already paid for. A replay never charges again and never creates a second job.

retry_after_s.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present on a deferred job; the same value is sent in the Retry-After header.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Fetch a completed SwishrJobs deliverable
